scientific_integrity: Analytic all-dimensional Choi/PPT and explicit finite separability proof; deterministic low-dimensional checks support but do not prove the result. Primary sources and non-covered antecedent cases are identified; independent publication-priority assessment is pending.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for full-rank d>=3 reset targets with at least three distinct eigenvalues and single-rate replacement interpolation; excludes general thermal generators, Hamiltonian driving and multi-rate noise. Priority comparison with all literature is not exhaustive.
title: Two-lowest-population law for entanglement breaking in anisotropic reset dynamics
